replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
I love the way it looks but it's incredibly flat. I suggest adding more mountains and make more gameplay options. 

Pros: 
It looks pleasing to the eye
The ground block palletes flow smoothly

Cons:
Flat
Not enough aesthetics
Will play no different than Fissura (I like the map but its incredibly short and there isn't much to it.)
